items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: he was in the band... John would put these pots on for us every day

ctx.x: He married her when she was 14 years old. Yes. And so he was in the band, and he's a great cook so we brought a big hot plate, and the only hotel we could stay in was a Chinese hotels out there and we had to cook our own food. And John would put these pots on for us every day and man we ate, we ate. Well, we was what you call sort of stranded in a way, but we did have --
